options.title: Closed on Shabbat — Settings
options.lede: The day-to-day settings live in the extension popup. This page holds only what does not fit there.
options.dismissedHint: Sites where you chose never to see the banner again. The toolbar badge still appears.
options.dismissedEmpty: You have not muted any site.
options.dataHint: The list ships with the extension, and is refreshed between releases from the project's public repository.
options.updatesHint: The extension checks the project's GitHub repository every few hours for a newer version of the list, and downloads it. Nothing about you or your browsing is sent. You can turn this off.
options.updatesBannerNote: A site added by an update gets a toolbar badge and a popup entry. The in-page banner for it arrives with the next version of the extension.
options.privacyBody: The extension collects nothing and sends nothing about your browsing. Every check runs on your own machine. The only network request it makes on its own is downloading the updated site list from GitHub — see "List updates" above.
options.privacyForms: Separately, when you click "Report a site" or "Appeal this listing", a Google Form opens in a new tab and the site's address travels to Google as part of the link. That happens only on your click.
options.privacyPermissions: Permissions are limited to the listed sites only — not to every site.
